name: Remote MCP Server
description: Enables deployment of MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers without authentication, allowing users to create custom tools and connect them to AI clients like Claude Desktop or Cloudflare AI Playground. Provides a template for building remote MCP servers that can be accessed via HTTP endpoints.
